# Chatbase

> > Chatbase is an AI chatbot platform that enables businesses to build custom AI agents powered by GPT-4, GPT-4o, and other LLMs for customer support automation, marketing, and knowledge base integration.

Chatbase allows users to create AI chatbots trained on their own data and deploy them across multiple channels including Slack, WhatsApp, WordPress, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, and Salesforce. The platform offers features like Agent Page (chat-first documentation), API access, event listeners, and enterprise-grade audit logs for compliance.

## Key Topics

- AI chatbots and agents
- Customer support automation
- GPT-4 and GPT-4o integration
- Chat widget deployment
- Marketing automation
- Chatbot API
- Agent Page (chat-first documentation)
- Integrations (Slack, WordPress, Salesforce, Notion)
- Support team cost reduction
- E-commerce AI assistants
- No-code chatbot building
- Vector embeddings and RAG
- Custom GPT integration
- Multi-channel deployment (WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram)
- Enterprise compliance (SOC 2, GDPR)

## Platform Documentation

- [Deploy - Chatbase](https://chatbase.co/docs/user-guides/chatbot/deploy): Deploy Chatbase agent to Slack, WhatsApp, WordPress, and other channels
- [Event Listeners - Chatbase](https://chatbase.co/docs/developer-guides/chatbot-event-listeners): JavaScript event listeners for real-time chat events and custom actions
- [Salesforce - Chatbase](https://chatbase.co/docs/user-guides/integrations/salesforce): Salesforce integration guide for Chatbase AI agent deployment
- [Bubble - Chatbase](https://chatbase.co/docs/user-guides/integrations/bubble): Integrate Chatbase agent with Bubble no-code platform using embed code
